name: Oof Dah Lite
summary: The rules are simple: grow more organic vegetables than your opponents. Whoever grows the most, wins! Growers will roll dice to determine how many actions they can do on their turn. There are two categories of actions: positive and negative. The higher number will always be positive, but growers can choose to do one or the other. When doubles are rolled, Balance has been achieved, and growers can do both positive and negative actions. Gambling may occur once per game, and if a grower rolls double ones or double sixes, a Melee Event may take place, and growers may choose to raid an opponent's crop and make it their own.
